notes.subject: יחוללו
notes.rationale: Root חול 'to twist/whirl': read as 'tremble/writhe' (JPS, ASV) vs 'are formed' (KJV, from חול as writhe in birth); tpi follows 'tremble'.

notes.subject: ol Refaim
notes.rationale: הרפאים literally 'the Rephaim' — the shades/dead; kept as name, not 'ol man i dai pinis'.

notes.subject: ושכניהם
notes.rationale: Singular suffix 'its inhabitants' (the water's) rendered with plural 'ol'; ambiguity kept loose with 'long en'.

translation: Ol Refaim i guria wantaim olgeta aninit long wara, na ol i save stap long en.

tokens.gloss: na ol i save stap long en
